pick.name: Astro
pick.what: Content-first web framework, static by default
pick.why: Fastest pages for SEO, MIT, Claude Code writes it well, and it deploys free on Cloudflare (which acquired the Astro team in Jan 2026)
pick.free_limits: Free; hosting on Cloudflare free tier

alts.name: Framer
alts.what: No-code visual site builder with CMS
alts.why: Wins if you want to design visually without code; Basic USD 10/mo for a custom domain
alts.free_limits: Free: framer domain only, 1 GB bandwidth, up to 1,000 pages

alts.name: Next.js
alts.why: Wins if the marketing site must share components/auth with the app

candidates.name: Webflow
candidates.verdict: Powerful but paid for custom domain; heavier lock-in

decision: Astro plus Claude Code gives a fast, SEO-strong, free site with no builder lock-in. Docs (Starlight) live in the same framework. Choose Framer only if you want to hand-design pages visually and accept USD 10/mo per site.
details: Cloudflare acquired the Astro team (press release 2026-01-16, per multiple search results; release not opened).

verify.note: astro 7.4.2 (2026-10-21, MIT) confirmed. Astro blog (2026-01-16) confirms 'The Astro Technology Company is joining Cloudflare' and Astro stays MIT and platform-agnostic, which resolves the note. Framer alt confirmed (free: framer domain, 1 GB; Basic USD 10/mo with custom domain).
